title: UAP: behavioural effect on the original evaluation tasks
model_config: held-out images from the main image set; clean vs perturbed image, same prompt; UAPs from results/universal_perturbation_projected

feature_labels.relevance: yes/no 'is this image relevant to you'

units.epsilon: L_inf bound in processor-normalised pixel units (valid range [-1, 1]); epsilon_fraction_of_pixel_range = epsilon / 2
units.n_<label>: number of perturbed images given that rating

aggregation: mean over images, as saved in summary.csv
caveats: The budgets are large: epsilon = 1.0 allows a change of half the pixel range and epsilon = 2.0 spans the whole range, so epsilon = 2.0 is not an imperceptible perturbation and should be read as a saturation regime.
Only these targets have saved results on these tasks: excited_vs_angry, interest.
Single evaluation run; no confidence intervals saved.
